newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar to send summit invitations in September.
newsitem.headline: Qatar to send summit invitations in September.

text.p: Qatar said on Wednesday it would start sending out invitations in September to a controversial Middle East and North Africa (MENA) economic summit and suggested Israel would be included.

"We will send out invitations to countries to attend the MENA summit in September," said Mohamed Ismail al-Emadi, assistant general coordinator for the conference and director of technical affairs at Qatar's Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
Asked how many countries would be invited to the November 16-18 conference, Emadi told reporters: "All those who had attended the Cairo summit last year."
Israel was among the 92 countries that sent 3,500 delegates to last year's summit in Cairo. Qatar had said that Israel's attendance was contingent on progress in Middle East peace talks.
Other government officials said Qatar was going ahead with preparations "full steam" despite pressure from some Arab countries to postpone the summit due to the stalled peace process.
Officials said between 2,500 and 3,500 delegates were expected to attend.
